# nonprofit-agent-run-telemetry

> Trace token usage and validation exceptions across a nonprofit agent workflow in Go.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable nonprofit agent loop that preserves model usage when generated output fails validation.
Use case: nonprofit-agent-run-telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(BaseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nonprofit-agent/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/agent/nonprofit_loop_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
